title: scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: a SIGTERM while the wrapped command waits leaves the target mutated — the restore the header promises never runs under spawnSync
body:
domain:ui#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSf5S4Kkc7aL9t5DSd

Filing gate: ① class (a), a measured defect with a named producer, from the os-dev-report 6821024885 on #32478 (`out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.

## What the header promises

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` lines ~97-103: "The mutation is armed with a restore on `exit`, `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` …". It names the agent environment's foreground cap as a SIGTERM source. The handlers are registered at ~line 492 (`for (const sig of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM', 'SIGHUP'])`).

## What was measured (the #32478 dev, ablation 2 of PR #32693)

- In WRAP mode the tool runs the command through `spawnSync` (~line 543). The wrapped command was waiting on the shared verify lock when the dev sent SIGTERM to the tool's own pid.
- The tool exited with no "SIGTERM received" line. The target file stayed at the mutated blob `72a11d408ecf`, while HEAD had `4b56e9559ad5`. The child lock waiter was left orphaned in the lock queue.
- The dev restored the file by hand (`git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, blob proven equal to HEAD) and killed the orphan.
- The dev's reading of the mechanism, unverified here: `spawnSync` blocks the event loop that the `process.on('SIGTERM')` handler needs, so the restore cannot run while the child is alive.

## Reach

Every dev that wraps a slow command (a lock wait or a build) in `ablation-replace.mjs` and gets cut by the foreground cap. The tree is left mutated with no message, and the next gate or commit sees a falsified file. The ablation reading itself is unaffected; the hazard is the tree that is left behind.

## Ask

Make the restore run on SIGTERM while a wrapped command is alive (for example, an async spawn whose parent can still handle the signal, or a child that the parent signals and then awaits). Pin it with a self-test that sends SIGTERM mid-wait and asserts the target's blob equals HEAD afterwards.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue ablation-replace SIGTERM` → 37 hits, none on this tool.
